name: project_link
title: Link repository to project
description: Add or update a repository in the project config

package.description: Monorepo package to register, as NAME:PATH. Example: pecot:plugins/pecot-workflow/CHANGELOG.md

clear_packages.description: Clear the existing packages setting. After clearing, the CHANGELOG falls back to `changelog_file` or the default CHANGELOG.md

release_type.description: Declare the release method explicitly; the w-release skill picks its procedure from it. single (1 CHANGELOG) / multi (packages) / nx (Nx Release). When omitted, it is inferred from the packages (with packages: multi, without: single)

change.description: create: the repository was added to the config; update: its entry was changed

configPath.description: Path of the project config file

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
